concepts.definition: F11 explains change entry, computed classification and reuse, ambiguity governance, and shared-interface migration. Its instance premises are changing specifications, one product intake for all report kinds, interfaces with several producers and consumers, and decisions made under policy or reserved to human authority. Its cited commitment standing is P0 recovered; P1, P2, P3, P4a and P6 independent; P4b derived from P0 and P2 under non-reacquirability of step-produced facts; P5 derived from P0 and P6 under the open-world premise. Its table accounts for §§4, 5 and 7 and distinguishes consequences from member-owned domain choices and project/profile policy.

grounding.quote:
Standing of

concepts.label: Foundation-to-law family F11

concepts.definition: Universal intake triage is the common entry for substantive change, including bugs, features, issues, regressions, operator findings, release blockers and scenario failures. It determines whether change is substantive, affected product boundary and scope, lawful class, constitutional re-entry point, downstream repricing/re-derivation/re-proof including evidence selection S_Δ over I(Δ), and whether the declared release scope suffices or its plan needs repricing. Diagnosis distinguishes defective realisation, inadequate governing requirement or design, inaccurate predictive model, and insufficient observation; supported repair is routed to the cause's owner. Severity and priority belong to TICKETS; a bug list projects existing work state.

grounding.quote: There is one front door for substantive change.

a defective realisation, an inadequate governing requirement or design, an
inaccurate predictive model, and insufficient observation

concepts.label: Universal intake triage

concepts.definition: The minimum lawful declared change states are: goal_reprice, changing bounded work-wave focus, re-entering Goals and flowing through Intent, Product, Requirements, Design, Code and Evidence where focus changes deeper constitutional truth; intent_reprice, changing direction or scope, re-entering Intent and flowing through Product, Requirements, Design, Code and Evidence; product_reprice, changing current product realisation with stable directional intent, re-entering Product and flowing through Requirements, Design, Code and Evidence; requirement_reprice, changing constitutional truth with stable project direction, re-entering Requirements and flowing through Design, Code and Evidence; design_reframe, changing realisation structure with stable active intent and requirement truth, re-entering Design and flowing through Code and Evidence; realization_refactor, local code/configuration/attribute change with no intended constitutional or structural change, re-entering only the realised surface, flowing nowhere upstream and requiring proof of no upstream drift.

concepts.definition: Intake supplies one reusable classification result. C denotes reproducible facts and declared-rule application; J denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; O denotes a ruling reserved to its actual owner. These annotations separate authority kinds without granting authority or introducing a calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface or mandatory document. Computed domains include relation changed/unchanged/unknown, identity added/removed/retained with changed value, and evidence covered/missing/stale/ambiguous/outside scope.

concepts.definition: The consistency gate applies the TICKETS §7 condition-based closure rule to obligations declared for a change span. Its proof concerns upstream sufficiency for downstream surfaces, absence of contradiction with active upstream truth, and tests and qualification of active intended behaviour rather than stale precedent. Gate evidence and result reuse belong to ACTIVATION §7; carrier work state belongs to TICKETS §7.

concepts.definition: A sprint is a bounded execution-control surface under existing goals, intent, product definition, requirement and design authority. It batches work and proof cost without becoming a constitutional layer. Sprint close is forensic reconciliation: compare accumulated work and evidence with authority, classify every gap, accept compliant work, open local-debt paydown work and escalate authority drift through its lawful class.

constitutional chain

concepts.definition: Two lawful constitutional strategies are inside-out hard-break migration, replacing authoritative source truth in place on the same implementation line, and fundamental re-adoption, intentionally re-deriving a major rewrite on a materially different implementation basis while treating the prior implementation as reference. Bounded evolution is a rebuttable selection presumption, not a third strategy.

Core interface and major implementation replacement work has two lawful
constitutional strategies

concepts.definition: An outcome's acceptance path is its full causal closure: every admitted entrypoint, producer, consumer, resolver, fallback, shared state, event, projection and proof surface capable of changing, interpreting or closing it. Singular authority is one governing authority throughout that closure, not a selected successful trace. A product slice derives identity and acceptance criteria from product, every causally applicable live requirement, accepted design relation and retained predecessor claim.

the outcome

concepts.definition: Fundamental migration is a constitutional reset with controlled explicit adoption. Inherited constitutional material is classified adopted, superseded, deferred or orphaned. Inherited implementation is carry_across when materially unchanged and intentionally re-adopted, redundant when no longer needed, or rewrite when needed but rebuilt under new requirements and design. These are declared states, not predecessor-claim dispositions.

constraints.statement: The ten consequence rows apply owner-only re-entry, evidence-tested diagnosis, recorded reusable classification, unknown preservation, conjunctive consistency closure, bounded deferred proof, recorded policy-governed ambiguity subject to hard stops, singular migration authority, shared-contract closure proof with persistent break evidence, and explicit adoption on a new line. Consumers apply their owning rules without adding decisions. The six named classes/four procedures, frame selection, C/J/O step details, sprint mechanics, ambiguity thresholds/split/order, migration strategies/old-path classes/inside-out order and inherited-material classes have the domain or policy ownership stated in the table; they are not supplied by commitments alone.
constraints.uncertainty: The table's owner and consumer references are only partly supplied; their additional law is unresolved.

conditions: A report enters substantive-change intake.

grounding.quote:
No bug, feature, issue or other intake bypasses this triage by going
straight to code, tests or release handling.

a counterexample that
one frame finds survives the join, and a frame planned and not applied
leaves its diagnosis open, never ruled out.

constraints.statement: Intake labels cannot select process class or bypass triage. Use the smallest sufficient applicable frame configuration over the same subject and basis; each frame tests diagnoses with its material variables, governing relations and evidence. Conjoin results while keeping each evaluated diagnosis as its predicate, preserving counterexamples, unresolved alternatives and uncertainty; planned-but-unapplied frames leave diagnoses open. Identify the smallest sufficient lawful repair scope. A failure-exposing frame need not contain its cause; renamed repeated analysis adds no evidence. Apply localisation where required and preserve required independence; this adds neither reviewer count nor review round. Diagnosis grants no repair effects and does not prove governing meaning must change; sufficient existing law may instead require candidate correction.
constraints.uncertainty: Frame applicability, conjunction and localisation rules are referenced rather than fully supplied.

grounding.quote:
Smaller changes may re-enter below Goals only if they explicitly assert
that no upstream constitutional surface is changing.

constraints.statement: Re-entry below Goals requires an explicit assertion of no upstream constitutional change. Missing declared class is process drift. A changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner, never merely inside the acting frame, regardless of delta size. Wherever substantive work begins, triage records intent, class, re-entry point and occurrence time; TICKETS records class on the carrier. Classes are declared states mapping to no core value, never evaluation results. An evaluation of a class has its own predicate/core value; a layer-naming close classification is such an evaluation with re-entry class as domain outcome. realization_refactor cannot substitute for satisfied proof of no upstream drift.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced close-classification mapping is not supplied.

conditions: C is produced.

grounding.quote:
Its output identifies the producer and procedure
revision, the inputs, the result, the scope, the source routes, the
reproduction relation, the unknowns and the invalidators.

constraints.statement: An explicitly selected source, worksite or qualification capability computes C over exact request/desired outcome, known targets/effects, operation grant/work lifetime, product definition/governing basis, baseline/available candidate, declared relations, accepted design/trace bindings, evidence and applicable rules. Record producer, procedure revision, inputs, result, scope, source routes, reproduction relation, unknowns and invalidators. Missing candidate or evidence is an input state, never evidence that nothing changed.

conditions: The computed result is exposed.
exceptions: A rename preserves identity only when its owner supplies an identity-preserving relation.

grounding.quote: The computed result exposes four things, in this order:

constraints.statement: Preserve this order: (1) Authority traversal follows explicit source, ownership, dependency, composition and projection declarations from affected targets/effects; records each reached layer/owner, exact basis, changed/unchanged/unknown relation, traversed edges and unresolved frontier; includes root/authority/grant changes despite equal public bytes. Missing edges prove no irrelevance; undeclared or uncertain materiality remains J. (2) Public delta enumerates the complete relevant serialised member universe under owner declaration/projection, including helper/generated dependencies; records additions/removals and every retained changed typed value or byte with exact before/after. Rename means removal plus addition absent the stated exception. Missing candidate, incomplete enumeration, ambiguous identity or unavailable projection leaves affected delta unknown; membership equality proves no value equality. (3) Coverage joins changed bytes/relations to explicit accepted scope, traces and acceptance evidence, distinguishing covered/missing/stale/ambiguous/outside-scope; filename, artifact listing or digest alone proves no coverage. Current trace coverage is C; semantic sufficiency remains J. (4) Treatment uses only declared rules with sufficient facts; records owners, matched predicates and consequences; exposes smallest lawful re-entry, next action, evidence/assessment, reserved ruling and carrier lifetime. Conflicts/missing premises remain unresolved; labels/filenames cannot select routes; settled rules require no invented J.
constraints.uncertainty: The operational traversal and computations are represented descriptively only.

grounding.quote:
Candidate
behaviour cannot author its own target law

Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance or promotion, not unrelated
authorised work.

constraints.statement: Classification facts map to no core evaluation value; covered or unchanged cannot substitute for satisfied, and consumed unknowns remain unknown. Public delta/nonconformance alone does not require contract change: with sufficient contract, reject or repair the candidate locally within grant. Re-enter the actual owner when the explicitly selected outcome requires changed meaning or an applicable assessment establishes insufficiency; C requires sufficient declared premises, intended meaning/necessity uncertainty stays J and reserved decisions stay O. Unknown treatment blocks dependent reliance/promotion only. An existing bounded construction/evidence grant may permit the cheapest useful discriminator, including a first candidate, without claiming conformance, under its exact subject, territory, operations and stops. Update affected C before dependent effects/promotion use new evidence. Correct mistaken routes at the smallest affected owner, preserving original cause, attempted subject, observed effect state and valid progress. Retry requires outcome, authority and safe-recovery conditions. completion_unknown, or not_effected without an established end, is not no effect and requires reconciliation before retry or dependent action.
constraints.uncertainty: ACTIVATION's recovery protocol and full effect semantics are not supplied.

conditions: Reuse after a new role, conversation or resumption, or a material change.

grounding.quote:
A new role, conversation or resumption reuses valid C after checking exact
applicability

constraints.statement: Reuse valid C only after exact-applicability checking. Before reliance invalidate affected claims on changes to request, candidate, owner/root relation, projection, design trace/acceptance, applied rule, configuration or material evidence, and also on changed basis or declared revising observation. Preserve predecessor/successor identities, changed inputs, surviving facts and affected J dependencies; recompute the wider frontier where independence is unproved. ACTIVATION §7 owns reuse/invalidation; TICKETS §7 owns existing carriers and recorded J/O continuity.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced continuity and general reuse laws are not fully supplied.

grounding.quote:
No gate closes while the affected active surfaces are internally
inconsistent

constraints.statement: Internal inconsistency or missing span proof keeps change open even if a local artifact looks correct. Closure requires the conjunction of declared obligations with valid evidence. A material mandatory-constraint counterexample, required judgment/ruling without a closed result, or uncovered obligation prevents closure and remains recorded by kind. Review event, passing aggregate, completed artifact or status change cannot substitute. During ticketed code/test mismatch, implementation behaviour is evidence, not authority; reconcile through the admitted ticket, triage, lawful re-entry and governing requirement/design/module/carrier/closure surface. TICKETS and ASSURANCE own the referenced test-authority rules.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete external closure and test-authority rules remain unexpanded.

conditions: A sprint is used.

grounding.quote: A lawful sprint states at least:

constraints.statement: State goal/work wave, depended-on upstream authority, admitted scope, excluded product/requirement/design/runtime/data-contract/governance boundaries, expected classes, any deferred local proof/compliance debt, closure trigger/law and debt paydown/repricing path. Proof deferral is lawful only while local, visible, bounded and repayable; escrow satisfies no closure until paid down, explicitly accepted under governing method or repriced upstream. Close may be recommended when time expires, scope is reached, changed surface makes review cheaper, uncertainty makes further work unsafe without reconciliation, or gaps indicate a wrong container; these are recommendations, not automatic closure. Discovery of goal/intent/product/requirement/design/runtime/data-contract/governance or other product-truth change is not landing authority: split, escalate, reprice or carry explicit paydown. Profiles may determine domain suitability of escrow.

conditions: Substantive work begins.

grounding.quote:
The triage fields are required wherever substantive work begins; a ticket
per change is not

constraints.statement: Required triage fields follow substantive work regardless of carrier; a separate ticket for every change is not required.

conditions: Any substantive intake or feature introduction/change.

grounding.quote:
only then treat the work as implementation, repricing or
release-bound change.

constraints.statement: Before treating intake as implementation/repricing/release work, triage/classify, determine lawful re-entry and identify the downstream consistency span. For features, update goals if wave/overriding concerns change, intent if purpose/scope changes, product if realisation/terms/boundaries/end-state shape changes; make requirements an explicit decomposition including lifecycle obligations or named gaps and classify every new/changed requirement. Establish governing structural design. Where the design profile applies, co-evolution requires its predicate; otherwise accept the smallest causally closed affected design set before retained implementation establishes unresolved, contradictory or materially non-equivalent relations. Outside that profile, co-evolution is permitted only with no unresolved material design decision; otherwise accept affected design before retained implementation establishes it. ADRs are a valid design form. Write scenarios for capability claims needing operational proof and other appropriate evidence for non-capability requirements. Prefer declarative problem/acceptance expression before imperative mechanism. Check successive goals→intent→product→requirements→design→implementation reconstruction sufficiency. Record/govern major boundary ambiguity by declared risk appetite. Develop under selected design, reconcile design/code/tests before promotion/closure and use events, projection and delta to test requirements against reality.

conditions: Bootstrap, requirement-surface repricing, or a gap revealed by a real use case.

grounding.quote: When bootstrapping a project or repricing a requirement surface:

constraints.statement: Bootstrap/repricing resolves product definition, verifies exact installed basis, loads declared bootstrap entrypoint then goals or bound work-wave carrier; performs goals→intent and intent→product with written/confirmed surfaces; gathers constitutional inputs and derives the live requirement surface. Individual files or grouped families are chosen for clarity without monolithic sprawl. Make that surface sole live requirement authority before design/code; prefer declarative structure and record remaining major ambiguity before downstream realisation. Only after it exists should downstream work count as constitutionally grounded. A real-use gap first receives triage/classification, then a scenario as its first substantive project artifact, then cause-localising gap analysis preserving unresolved alternatives, then class-selected re-entry and forward flow. New goals/intent are written only when wave, direction or scope changes. Bug/feature/test/release/operator origin never bypasses this order.

Ambiguity detection is
mandatory; blocking is policy

constraints.statement: At every major boundary detect and record remaining/new major ambiguity, affected invariant/asset/decision boundary, decision if work proceeds and outcome resolved/carried/escalated/blocked. Major ambiguity cannot hide in informal judgment, precedent or silent model choice. No dependent claim treats carried/escalated/blocked as resolved. Declared risk appetite, not convenience, sets the policy threshold for bounded processing versus admitted human adjudication; lower appetite escalates more, higher permits more bounded decisions, always with ambiguity and decision recorded. ACTIVATION hard stops hold regardless of appetite. Progressive visibility/governance/reduction, not elimination before all work, is required. An unanswered lifecycle phase is a recorded gap, never silent absence. Profile runtime shorthand otherwise remains in its profile context.

it is not an exact dependency, evidence or constitutional

Shared realisation surfaces should describe current truth by role, boundary and status rather than release-line labels. Release publication/criteria/selector advancement and successor conservation remain RELEASE-owned. Tools, runtimes, carrier schemas and assurance implementations cannot enter the method merely by accompanying a lesson; each needs Product authorisation. Other standards consume admitted law by reference; consumers select one complete released version without mixing cuts.

conditions: A core-interface migration is undertaken.

grounding.quote: change the authoritative core contract first

constraints.statement: Change authoritative core contract first; prohibit authoritative bridge code for its family; audit and migrate every producer and consumer; pursue every downstream effect until no superseded closure law remains. Complete migration-closure proof follows completion of the wave; bounded slice proof follows the separate path-relative rule. It is forbidden to declare complete a split state with old/new producers, divergent runtime/reporting/topology carriers, authoritative aliases or second-truth projections, even if tests pass.

exceptions: The evolution presumption does not require an unsafe or inadmissible predecessor path or preserve mechanisms explicitly superseded by product authority.

grounding.quote:
evolution on the
supported product path is the rebuttable selection presumption.

constraints.statement: Presume bounded evolution only where both strategies are lawful and feasible and a working predecessor can reach the admitted outcome without competing/ambiguous authority; conserve accepted predecessor semantics and feedback. Core-interface evolution uses inside-out hard breaks. Fundamental re-adoption requires explicit selection by the human owner of the affected product boundary, comparing product value, feedback latency, authority risk, reversibility, total cost and retained predecessor semantics and stating a bounded abort/re-entry condition. Scale or architectural preference alone cannot select it.

exceptions: Residual material outside the promoted path may be deferred only under all stated path-relative conditions.

grounding.quote: Product-slice promotion and complete migration closure are distinct claims.

constraints.statement: Both strategies forbid proxy partial implementations standing for the new contract in any acceptance path and silently authoritative bridge/fallback paths. Promotion requires singular unambiguous authority across the full causal closure; old/new admissibility for the same request, fact, identity, state or projection blocks promotion. Outside-path residual material may be deferred only if explicitly non-authoritative for the outcome OR governing an explicitly specified disjoint product/compatibility scope with deterministic routing, AND unable to falsify current/retained claims, AND retaining a bounded migration/qualification/release disposition. Intermediate promotion requires singular path authority and compliant residual deferment; it neither closes migration nor waives retirement. Ticket/review wording cannot narrow slice authority. Migration status does not renew exhausted accepted-slice growth authority: admitted removal/demotion/closure-proof work may continue within its bound without claiming product progress; further material producer/consumer growth needs another still-live §3 basis, not ticket activity. Tests detect leaks and supply proof, not migration plans.
constraints.uncertainty: The still-live growth-basis rule in §3 is outside this supplied span.

constraints.statement: Declare exact affected scope; every excluded/disjoint product or compatibility scope and deterministic routing; new authoritative and superseded contracts/surfaces; new closure law; full old/new producer and consumer sets; and every derived projection/report/status/proof surface. Classify every old path remove, replace, re-authorize or temporary scaffolding. Temporary scaffolding is lawful only if explicitly non-authoritative and scheduled for removal before closure.

constraints.statement: No compatibility alias remains authoritative; no silent fallback identity law remains; no bridge participates in acceptance as the new contract; no old reader/writer remains authoritative for an outcome governed by the new contract; no proxy/partial new interface may stand between old/new truth as completion, subject only to the specified compatibility-feature exception.

A dependent projection ticket cannot close before its source-carrier ticket; ticket dependencies explicitly expose outward order. Each break publishes/admits the deepest new source carrier, deliberately severs one authoritative seam and keeps it broken, repairs consumers then projections then prompts/reports then proof surfaces, and negatively proves rejection rather than nonuse. Temporary compatibility/comparison has expiry/removal trigger; tests, oracle labels or nominal demotion do not justify duplicate production duties. Identify the surviving owner when an obligation survives; no governing basis means no required replacement guard. Declare the migration line; create fresh method/goals/intent/product/requirements/design surfaces; move prior implementation sideways if needed to prevent ambient authority; classify both constitutional and implementation material; copy only intentional retention and derive design/code from new surfaces. carry_across is explicit adoption, not automatic copying.
